user_question: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Aggregate total population by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate total population for each census tract from the supplied ACS table.
workflow_steps.instructions: Group the input table by GEOID and sum total_pop. Preserve GEOID as the tract identifier and output one record per tract.

workflow_steps.title: Join population totals to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach tract-level population totals to the supplied Centre County census tract polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join population_by_tract to the tract polygons using GEOID in both datasets. Preserve the polygon geometry and all tract identifiers.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate land area by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the requested tract-level population and land-area results from the joined polygon dataset.
workflow_steps.instructions: Using the joined tract polygon layer, calculate land area for each census tract and retain the tract identifier and joined total population. Output one record per census tract with the population total and calculated land-area value.
